@@ -1,4 +1,6 @@
 from openlibrary.plugins.openlibrary import lists
+from openlibrary.plugins.upstream import utils
+import web
 
 
 def test_process_seeds():
@@ -11,3 +13,53 @@ def test_process_seeds():
     assert f({"key": "/books/OL1M"}) == {"key": "/books/OL1M"}
     assert f("/subjects/love") == "subject:love"
     assert f("subject:love") == "subject:love"
+
+
+def test_list_record_post_uses_body_instead_of_query(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(web, 'data', lambda: b'name=Body+list&name=ignored&description=From+body&seeds--0--key=%2Fbooks%2FOL1M&seeds--1--key=')
+    monkeypatch.setattr(web, 'input', lambda **defaults: web.storage(name='Query list', seeds='bad'))
+
+    record = lists.ListRecord.from_input()
+
+    assert record.name == 'Body list'
+    assert record.description == 'From body'
+    assert record.seeds == [{'key': '/books/OL1M'}]
+
+
+def test_list_record_post_ignores_invalid_nested_seeds(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(web, 'data', lambda: b'name=List&seeds--0--foo=bad&seeds--1--key=%2Fbooks%2FOL2M')
+    monkeypatch.setattr(web, 'input', lambda **defaults: web.storage(name='Query list'))
+
+    assert lists.ListRecord.from_input().seeds == [{'key': '/books/OL2M'}]
+
+
+def test_list_record_post_ignores_invalid_indexed_seed(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(web, 'data', lambda: b'name=List&seeds--0=bad&seeds--1=%2Fbooks%2FOL2M')
+    monkeypatch.setattr(web, 'input', lambda **defaults: web.storage())
+
+    assert lists.ListRecord.from_input().seeds == [{'key': '/books/OL2M'}]
+
+
+def test_list_record_post_accepts_plain_seed_field(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(web, 'data', lambda: b'name=List&seeds=%2Fbooks%2FOL2M')
+    monkeypatch.setattr(web, 'input', lambda **defaults: web.storage())
+
+    assert lists.ListRecord.from_input().seeds == [{'key': '/books/OL2M'}]
+
+
+def test_list_record_query_defaults_without_body(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(web, 'data', lambda: b'')
+    monkeypatch.setattr(web, 'input', lambda **defaults: web.storage({**defaults, 'name': 'Query list'}))
+
+    record = lists.ListRecord.from_input()
+    assert record.name == 'Query list'
+    assert record.description == ''
+    assert record.seeds == []
+
+
+def test_unflatten_last_simple_assignment_wins():
+    assert utils.unflatten({'a--x': 1, 'a': {'x': 2}}).a.x == 2
+
+
+def test_unflatten_later_nested_assignment_replaces_scalar():
+    assert utils.unflatten({'a': 1, 'a--x': 2}).a.x == 2
